one_line: Pioneering Indian chemist and first Director-General of CSIR who built India’s post-independence national laboratory network.

appearance.age_look: Early 50s, medium height, slightly rounded build with the presence of a senior scholar-administrator.
appearance.face: Oval face, wheatish complexion, neatly trimmed black moustache, thoughtful calm eyes behind round spectacles, default expression a gentle, focused half-smile that feels encouraging and reflective.
appearance.hair: Short, neatly combed black hair with slight receding hairline, parted to the left, always wearing a cream woollen Gandhi cap snugly on the crown.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate Nehruvian formal attire: a mid-thigh length charcoal-grey woollen bandhgala/closed-neck coat with five visible buttons and two subtle lower pockets, worn over an off-white long-sleeve kurta and straight-cut off-white cotton churidar trousers; simple black leather lace-up shoes; a plain steel wristwatch on the left hand; no flashy jewellery, just a modest scholar’s look.
appearance.signature: A tan leather folder held in his left hand, slightly worn at the edges, with rolled architectural blueprints for a laboratory protruding from the top and a single steel fountain pen clipped to the folder’s edge.

ref_desc: Shanti Swaroop Bhatnagar is a early-50s, wheatish-complexioned man with round spectacles, short parted black hair under a cream Gandhi cap, in a charcoal-grey bandhgala over off-white kurta-churidar, black shoes, carrying a tan folder with lab blueprints and pen.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style male character based on Shanti Swaroop Bhatnagar: an early-50s, medium-height, slightly rounded Indian scientist-administrator with an oval wheatish face, neat black moustache and thoughtful eyes behind round spectacles, his short black hair parted left and covered by a cream Gandhi cap. He wears a charcoal-grey woollen bandhgala coat with a closed stand-up collar, five front buttons and two subtle lower pockets, over an off-white long-sleeve kurta and straight-cut off-white churidar trousers, finished with simple black leather lace-up shoes and a plain steel wristwatch on his left wrist. In his left hand he firmly holds a tan leather folder, edges slightly worn, with rolled architectural blueprints for a laboratory clearly protruding from the top and a single steel fountain pen clipped to the folder’s edge. Use a restrained, dignified colour scheme of charcoal grey, off-white, cream, tan and black, and pose him in a calm, confident stance that conveys visionary leadership in building national research laboratories.
